mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trips (member_id, title, start_date, end_date, budget_amount, companion_preference) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{budgetAmount}, #{companionPreference})

INSERT INTO trip_regions (trip_id, region_code, region_name, display_order) VALUES
(#{region.tripId}, #{region.regionCode}, #{region.regionName}, #{region.displayOrder})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE region_name = VALUES(region_name), display_order = VALUES(display_order), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE trips SET title = #{title}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, budget_amount = #{budgetAmount}, companion_preference = #{companionPreference}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE trip_regions SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT trip_id, member_id, title, start_date, end_date, budget_amount, companion_preference, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_items ti JOIN explore_items ei ON ei.item_id = ti.item_id AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ti.item_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.trip_id = trips.trip_id AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND ei.item_type = 'EVENT' ) AS event_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_items ti JOIN explore_items ei ON ei.item_id = ti.item_id AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN place p ON p.place_id = ti.item_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.trip_id = trips.trip_id AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND ei.item_type = 'PLACE' ) AS place_count, ( /* * 커버 사진. * * 여정에 담긴 항목 가운데 타임라인에서 가장 먼저 나오는 것의 썸네일이다. * 순서는 상세 타임라인(findJourneyTimelineItems)과 같은 * `visit_date -> display_order -> trip_item_id`를 쓴다. 두 화면이 다른 * 항목을 첫 번째라고 부르면 목록의 사진과 상세의 첫 줄이 어긋난다. * * 썸네일이 없는 항목은 건너뛴다. 첫 항목에 사진이 없다고 커버를 비우면 * 뒤에 사진이 있는데도 자리표시가 나온다. 장소는 썸네일이 없는 비율이 * 40%대라 첫 항목이 비는 일이 실제로 있다. */ SELECT COALESCE(e.thumbnail_url, p.thumbnail_url) FROM trip_items ti JOIN explore_items ei ON ei.item_id = ti.item_id AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN place p ON p.place_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.trip_id = trips.trip_id AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(e.thumbnail_url, p.thumbnail_url) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ti.visit_date ASC, ti.display_order ASC, ti.trip_item_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS cover_image_url FROM trips WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY start_date ASC, trip_id DESC
SELECT trip_id, member_id, title, start_date, end_date, budget_amount, companion_preference FROM trips WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( le.amount - ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sm.share_amount), 0) FROM settlements s JOIN settlement_members sm ON sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND sm.request_status = 'PAID' AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.source_transfer_id = t.transfer_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ) ), 0) FROM wallet_ledger_entries le JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = le.transfer_id JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = le.wallet_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN wallet_owners wo ON wo.wallet_owner_id = w.wallet_owner_id AND wo.member_id = #{memberId} AND wo.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN trips tr ON tr.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tr.member_id = #{memberId} AND tr.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE le.entry_type = 'DEBIT' AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.currency_code = 'KRW' AND t.transfer_status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.transfer_type IN ('QR_PAYMENT', 'SETTLEMENT') AND DATE(t.completed_at) BETWEEN tr.start_date AND tr.end_date
SELECT trip_id, member_id, title, start_date, end_date, budget_amount, companion_preference FROM trips WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM trip_items WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (visit_date < #{startDate} OR visit_date > #{endDate}) )
SELECT trip_id, region_code, region_name, display_order FROM trip_regions WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY display_order ASC, region_code ASC

SELECT ti.trip_item_id, ti.item_id, ti.appointment_id, ti.visit_date, ti.trip_item_status AS status, ti.display_order, ti.note, ei.item_type, CASE WHEN ei.item_type = 'EVENT' THEN COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(et_requested.title), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(et_english.title), ''), e.title ) ELSE COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pt_requested.name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pt_english.name), ''), p.name ) END AS title, COALESCE(e.thumbnail_url, p.thumbnail_url) AS thumbnail_url, CASE WHEN ei.item_type = 'EVENT' THEN e.image_urls ELSE p.image_urls END AS image_urls, COALESCE(e.region1, p.region1) AS region1, COALESCE(e.region2, p.region2) AS region2, COALESCE(e.region3, p.region3) AS region3, CASE WHEN ei.item_type = 'EVENT' THEN COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(et_requested.address_display), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(et_english.address_display), ''), e.address_road ) ELSE COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pt_requested.address_display), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pt_english.address_display), ''), p.address_road ) END AS address_road, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pt_requested.address_detail), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pt_english.address_detail), ''), p.address_detail ) AS address_detail, COALESCE(e.latitude, p.latitude) AS latitude, COALESCE(e.longitude, p.longitude) AS longitude, e.event_kind, e.start_date AS event_start_date, e.end_date AS event_end_date, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(et_requested.organizer), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(et_english.organizer), ''), e.organizer ) AS organizer, COALESCE( CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_EXTRACT(e.pre_reservation, '$.has') ) = 'true' THEN NULLIF( JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_EXTRACT(e.pre_reservation, '$.link') ), '' ) END, NULLIF(e.reservation_url, ''), NULLIF( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.links, '$.reservationUrl')), '' ), NULLIF( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.links, '$.reservation_url')), '' ) ) AS event_reservation_url, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(et_requested.venue_detail), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(et_english.venue_detail), ''), e.venue_name ) AS venue_name, p.place_kind, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pt_requested.menu_summary), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pt_english.menu_summary), ''), p.menu_summary ) AS menu_summary, p.is_active AS place_active, a.activity_start_at, a.activity_end_at, a.appointment_status FROM trip_items ti JOIN explore_items ei ON ei.item_id = ti.item_id AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN place p ON p.place_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN event_translations et_requested ON et_requested.event_id = e.event_id AND et_requested.language_code = #{language} AND et_requested.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN event_translations et_english ON et_english.event_id = e.event_id AND et_english.language_code = 'en' AND et_english.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN place_translations pt_requested ON pt_requested.place_id = p.place_id AND pt_requested.language_code = #{language} AND pt_requested.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN place_translations pt_english ON pt_english.place_id = p.place_id AND pt_english.language_code = 'en' AND pt_english.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = ti.appointment_id AND a.item_id = ti.item_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.event_id IS NOT NULL) OR (ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.place_id IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY ti.visit_date ASC, ti.display_order ASC, ti.trip_item_id ASC

SELECT ei.item_id, ei.item_type, e.start_date, e.end_date FROM explore_items ei LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'EVENT' LEFT JOIN place p ON p.place_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'PLACE' WHERE ei.item_id = #{itemId} AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL AND ei.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND ei.visibility_status = 'VISIBLE' AND ( (ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.event_id IS NOT NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE())) OR (ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.place_id IS NOT NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.is_active = TRUE) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_items (trip_id, item_id, appointment_id, visit_date, trip_item_status, display_order, note, confirmed_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{itemId}, NULL, #{visitDate}, 'ADDED', #{displayOrder}, #{note}, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT trip_item_id, trip_id, item_id, visit_date, trip_item_status, display_order, note, appointment_id, confirmed_at FROM trip_items WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND item_id = #{itemId} AND visit_date = #{visitDate} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_items (trip_id, item_id, appointment_id, visit_date, trip_item_status, display_order, note, confirmed_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{itemId}, #{appointmentId}, #{visitDate}, 'CONFIRMED', #{displayOrder}, #{note}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT ti.trip_item_id, ti.trip_id, ti.item_id, ei.item_type, ti.visit_date, ti.trip_item_status, ti.display_order, ti.note, ti.appointment_id, ti.confirmed_at, ti.created_at FROM trip_items ti JOIN explore_items ei ON ei.item_id = ti.item_id WHERE ti.trip_item_id = #{tripItemId} AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ti.trip_item_id, ti.trip_id, ti.item_id, ti.visit_date, ti.trip_item_status, ti.display_order, ti.note, ti.appointment_id, a.host_member_id AS appointment_host_member_id, am.membership_status AS appointment_membership_status, ti.confirmed_at, ti.created_at FROM trip_items ti LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = ti.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_id = ti.appointment_id AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND am.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ti.trip_item_id = #{tripItemId} AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT ti.trip_item_id, ti.trip_id, ti.item_id, ti.trip_item_status, ti.appointment_id, a.host_member_id AS appointment_host_member_id, am.membership_status AS appointment_membership_status FROM trip_items ti LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = ti.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_id = ti.appointment_id AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND am.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ti.trip_item_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ti.trip_item_id ASC FOR UPDATE
